name: Madyes
contribution: A Scythian king who ruled during the period of the Scythian presence in West Asia in the 7th century BCE.
legacy: The Graeco-Roman authors conflated this person with his predecessors and successors into a single figure by claiming that it was this person himself who led the Scythians from Central Asia into chasing the Cimmerians out of their homeland and then defeating the Medes and the legendary Egyptian king Sesostris and imposing their rule over Asia for many years before returning to Scythia.

checks.lead: Madyes was a Scythian king who ruled during the period of the Scythian presence in West Asia in the 7th century BCE.
